_physiology_help: Only the Analytics > Trends HR-derived VO2max estimate reads this block.
hr_max: true maximum heart rate. Unset, the highest bpm ever recorded is used,
which understates it unless you have actually run yourself to the line.
hr_rest: resting heart rate, measured lying down before getting up. Unset, 60 is assumed.
Both shift the absolute estimate; neither changes its direction of travel.
_duplicates_help: Manual corrections to automatic duplicate detection, all keyed by Activity ID.
Run the hub once and read the 'Duplicate runs' block it prints to get the IDs.
not_duplicates: pairs that are two real runs, never collapse them.
force_duplicate: loser -> winner pairs the heuristic missed.
force_primary: pin which recording survives in its group.
Applied in that order, later steps outranking earlier ones.
